artworks.title: Bouquet envoyé ... A l'empereur de Russie ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of a man on horseback next to a large bouquet held by multiple figures. The drawing shows a caricature of a bearded man wearing a hat riding a horse and holding a stick. Several figures are humorously carrying an oversized bouquet with three faces emerging from it. The sketch is detailed with shading and line work to depict motion. The artwork conveys whimsy and critique, typical of satirical art.

artworks.title: Le nouvel Icare ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a figure falling through the air with an exaggerated pose and expression. The person wears a helmet, shoulder-length hair, is shirtless, and wears dark pants. They have broken wings on their back. The background includes outlines of buildings labeled "BOMARSUND" and "SEBASTOPOL," with a sun in the top right corner. The ground is minimally depicted with simple lines. No jewelry or additional objects are present.

artworks.title: Giboulées de mars a Sébastopol
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a stormy environment with flying debris. The image depicts a scene with two figures bracing against a strong wind and heavy rain.

artworks.title: A la mairie ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three people are depicted in a room. From left to right: a man with curly hair and hands behind his back, a woman with a headscarf and hands on a counter, and a man holding a document and facing left. The background shows indistinct faces and plain walls with paneling.

artworks.title: Nouvelles positions prises par les russes ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wearing military attire and engaging with a map labeled "VALACHIE". The image features exaggerated, almost caricatured military uniforms, complete with tall boots and large hats. One figure is seated and observing a map marked "VALACHIE" with interest, while the other stands with a hand to its head in a reflective pose. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical illustrations, employing broad lines and shading that give the figures a comical and exaggerated appearance. The composition is both humorous and critical, as suggested by the captions around the drawing.

artworks.title: A louer, logements de garçon entre le ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing featuring a partial view of two individuals. On the right, a person is visible from the shoulders up, positioned inside what appears to be a small window of a large, horizontally-oriented basket-like structure. This individual has distinct facial features, including wide eyes and a bulbous nose, and wears a pointy hat along with a textured, checkered garment. Next to this person, there appears to be an object resembling a plate or circular item. On the left side of the image, another person is partially visible, crouched down inside a similar window, but their specific features are less distinct due to the sketch's shading. The surrounding structure gives the appearance of being constructed from tightly packed, rounded bundles. Above, there is a background with lighter lines indicating structures and figures that resemble an elevated bridge with people walking on it. The rest of the background is filled with faint lines suggesting supporting structures or bridges.

artworks.title: T'nez v'la l'seul logement d'garçon ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a caricature scene related to property rental. The image shows one person standing in front of a small doghouse marked as available for rent, while another person leans over a railing and points towards the doghouse. The style is exaggerated and reminiscent of 19th-century satirical illustrations with intentionally distorted lines and proportions for comedic effect. The scene humorously critiques housing conditions or property availability, as seen through the characters' expressions and postures.

artworks.title: Tenue de canicule
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. Both are facing forward with a slight upward head tilt. The person on the left has short hair and round glasses, while the person on the right has wavy short hair. Both are in loose, knee-length garments and sandals, each holding a large fan. The person on the left also holds an umbrella covering both. Faint outlines of buildings, a shaded path with trees, and a smaller figure walking away on the left holding an umbrella can be seen in the background. The setting seems to be an outdoor city scene.

artworks.title: M. Prud'homme ... Je ne sais pas si ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man rowing a boat, a figure in a sailor's uniform, and a rotund man in a dark suit in the boat. The setting suggests the boat is on rough water, with a building visible in the distant background.

artworks.title: Bertrand et Raton
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting across a riverbank. One figure stands with a surprised expression, holding a club-like object and looking towards the other side. The second figure on the opposite bank appears to be making a loud noise, with one hand near their mouth and holding a lifeless animal. The background is minimal, suggesting an outdoor environment near water, with undulating lines representing a river. The scene conveys urgency or conflict through the postures and expressions of the figures. The title at the top is "Émotions de Chasse," which translates to "Emotions of the Hunt," with the caption "Bertrand et Raton."

artworks.title: Ce messieurs ont ... du gibier a déclarer? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people seated on a vehicle being approached by an officer. The scene depicts an officer standing beside a vehicle, engaging with three figures seated on it. The vehicle occupants wear hunting attire and appear weary. The officer leans slightly forward with an inquisitive stance. The background is minimally detailed, suggesting a rural or rustic backdrop with faint outlines of structures or landscape. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Faut-il qu'un animal soit bête
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a hunting scene. One man is in the foreground, standing defensively with a surprised expression on his face, holding a rifle. In front of him, a rabbit is leaping away. The second man, positioned slightly to the left and behind, is also armed and dressed for hunting. The background includes a tree and sparse landscape, with birds in the sky. The drawing has soft tones and shading.

artworks.title: Ils ont beau m'avoir dit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men sitting on a bench. The central figure wears a dark suit, a waistcoat, and a top hat. He has round eyes and a pointed nose. The men on either side hold rifles. The man on the left wears a knitted cap and a jacket with a strap, while the man on the right wears a flat cap and a similar jacket. Both have facial hair. The background has vertical lines and a lighter section. A subtitle in French is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Un monsieur en bonne fortune aux Champs-Elysées
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man holding a map or letter as he navigates through a forest of numbered trees. The drawing depicts a stylized scene set in a forest where trees are numbered with signs such as "308", "345", "918", etc. The main character appears in the foreground wearing formal attire including a top hat. He seems to be searching for a particular tree while holding a piece of paper. The use of lines and shading gives a sense of depth and the tall trees, creating an engaging atmosphere. The background features additional figures similarly attired, possibly suggesting a group environment in a park-like setting. The drawing has a satirical style.

artworks.title: Commission des bastonnades
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures. The image depicts a formal scene where a man in a suit is flanked by two rough-looking, barefoot men holding sticks, while across from him a group of seated men, one of whom is wearing a large hat with a plume, appear to be part of an inquisition or tribunal. The scene is rendered in black and white, with detailed linework that captures expressive body language and exaggerated features. There is text at the bottom, which implies dialogue or context for the depicted scenario.

artworks.title: Nouveaux chapeaux de dames ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two central figures. The man stands upright holding an umbrella in one hand and the woman walks beside him. The man has exaggerated facial features, a long nose, and arched eyebrows, and is wearing a top hat, checked waistcoat, dark coat, and light-colored pants. The woman wears a wide-brimmed hat covering her face, a flowing gown with a tightly fitted bodice, and a full skirt. She holds a small object. In the background, many figures with similar wide-brimmed hats walk through a park with trees.

artworks.title: Tristesse des bouchers de Paris ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a butcher shop scene. The drawing depicts a butcher behind a counter with a large scale and a piece of meat on it. There are hanging cuts of meat in the background. The focus is on the butcher's expression and the overall atmosphere of the shop. The style suggests a comedic yet critical commentary.

artworks.title: Ah! Ciel, ma plus belle potiche! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene involving three figures interacting. The room contains furniture, two small vases on a couch and a table. The figures include two men and a woman who appears to be gesturing. The setting features detailed etching, with patterned wallpaper, framed pictures, and crockery on a side table. The scene suggests a moment of surprise or exclamation, with one vase displayed on the floor. The drawing is in black and white with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Tiens, voila mamzelle palmyre qui fait ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several people in a room. In the foreground, there are two individuals - a man in formal attire with a tall hat and a woman holding a decorative jug. Their expressions suggest they are looking towards the right of the scene. In the background, there is a window showing a woman working inside a separate room with the words "PARLEZ AU COMMERCE" visible. The drawing is done in a caricature style with exaggerated features and expressions, possibly for a satirical purpose. The figures and the narrative are emphasized through shading and line work.

artworks.title: Je crois pouvoir dire, sans me flatter ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures, capturing their full bodies. The central figure is a woman, standing and holding an ornate pot up to examine it closely, with her head tilted back slightly. She has styled hair, possibly pulled back, and wears a patterned, long dress with puffed short sleeves. Next to her, an older man leans forward, closely observing the pot. He has short, curly hair and is dressed in a striped waistcoat over a collared shirt. To the left, a young child stands, wearing an oversized, ornately decorated hat, along with a tunic and shorts, looking to the side with arms crossed. The background consists of framed artwork hanging on a wall and a round table with various vases and a bottle on top. The room has a simple interior with visible drapery.

artworks.title: C'est pourtant bien facheux pour ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two full-body caricatures of men standing and facing each other in a simple line drawing style. The man on the left is bald with a rotund figure, wearing loose-fitting clothes and holding a wig and comb. The man on the right is slim with disheveled hair, holding large dentures. The background is plain with horizontal lines suggesting ground. The text at the top reads "CES BONS PARISIENS."

artworks.title: Ah! Monsieur Gobinet, dans quel temps ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men conversing on a street. They are standing facing each other. One man extends his right arm towards the other, who is holding a cane. The man on the left has a narrow face with prominent eyes, wearing a long coat and a top hat. The man on the right has a round face with a large nose, dressed similarly and holding a cane. The background depicts an urban scene with buildings and street details. The illustration has a drawn, monochrome aesthetic.

artworks.title: Un jour ou l'on paye cinq francs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures examining a display of large pumpkins on a table. The color scheme is black and white, with grey tones adding texture. The figures are on the left side, dressed in 19th-century clothing, with two wearing tall top hats. The pumpkins are on the right side, partly hidden by the figures.

artworks.title: M. Prudhomme visitant les ateliers ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a gallery. One man is on the left, viewing a painting, wearing a dark jacket, white waistcoat, and striped trousers. The other man, on the right, is standing upright holding a cigar, wearing a lighter-colored suit with a waistcoat and tie. The room contains several framed paintings on the walls, with one in front of the first man. The background shows a wood-paneled floor and walls with more framed artwork.
